get.summary: Retrieve current and historical risk state with explanation.
get.description: Read current and historical objective risk from immutable evaluations. UACRF_OBJECTIVE_RISK_V1 maps a confirmed objective breach to HIGH, all objectives confirmed met to LOW, and incomplete results to UNKNOWN; MEDIUM and CRITICAL are reserved and never inferred by this version. This is observed objective risk, not a forecast or execution permission. History preserves original results, qualification, case/result fingerprints and observation/recording times. The separate current summary becomes UNKNOWN when the latest authorized evaluation context is stale, expired or changed; no older low-risk row is substituted. Latest and history sort by measurement cutoff, recording time and identifier descending. Signed scope/filter/authority-bound cursors preserve an upper history boundary; current summary is recomputed each read. New immutable results below that boundary may appear: pagination is not a transactional snapshot. Reads require evaluation and all case disclosure permissions; agent anchors additionally require workload.read. Source files are not reread on this metadata projection; REVERIFY_AT_USE remains explicit. Absence is UNKNOWN, never healthy.

post.summary: Create a provider-neutral action recommendation.
post.description: Retain an immutable provider-neutral recommendation against an exact current analysis case. Targets, bounds, reversibility, prerequisites, expected effect, recovery path, validation, and compensation remain explicit declarations. Server derives tenant, environment and producer from verified identity. Candidate and bounds references must identify exact retained bytes. expected_revision must be zero; use a new candidate identity for changes. Admission commits command/input/audit/outbox and returns 202, never domain success. A dedicated worker re-verifies the actual graph, signed policy, observations, qualification, source attribution, complete declaration and scoped-purpose reference bytes outside database locks. It commits only under unchanged current context, authority, deadline and fenced lease. Successful completion retains RECOMMENDATION_RETAINED_NOT_EXECUTABLE with CONTENT_BYTES_ONLY_NOT_SAFETY_QUALIFIED references. It does not qualify safety plans, decide policy, approve or authorize an action. Missing prerequisites block executable use. Follow command result_ref after success. Stable scoped key/request replays the original receipt; changed content returns409. A producer cannot overwrite or duplicate a retained candidate identity.

post.summary: Seal an independently attributable analysis case.
post.description: Synchronously seal attributable advisory input against an exact current fixed analysis case. The service verifies actual graph, signatures and evidence outside SQL locks, then commits only an unchanged case and authenticated producer context. Identity and producer kind come from current verified principal records. expected_revision must be zero, and graph/policy/evidence-manifest references and digest must match the source case exactly. HTTP200 is a completed immutable seal, not an agent finding, model-generated output, approval or action authority. Stable scoped key/request replays the same seal under current disclosure; changed content conflicts. Historical reads preserve the original fingerprint and report current eligibility separately.
